error_certificate_changed: The server's certificate has changed. The connection was stopped to keep you safe.
error_server_too_old: This server runs a version of Mumble that is too old for Mumcord.
error_banned: You are banned from this server.
error_not_found: This server entry no longer exists.
error_permission_denied: The server did not allow this.

error_duplicate_identity: This identity is already on this phone.
error_last_identity: You cannot delete your last identity.
error_no_identity: Create or import an identity first.
local_network_text: {{arg1}} is on your local network, and Android only lets Mumcord reach it if you allow access to nearby devices.
local_network_denied: Mumcord may not access your local network, so it cannot reach this server. Allow “Nearby devices” for Mumcord in the system settings, then try again.
local_network_suspected: The server could not be reached. If it is on your local network, Mumcord needs access to nearby devices: try again to allow it.
certificate_unknown_message: Mumcord has not seen this server before and cannot confirm its identity on its own. If you know the server's fingerprint, compare it with the one below.
certificate_changed_message: The server presents a different certificate than the one you trusted before. Someone may be trying to intercept your connection. Only continue if the server's operator has confirmed the change.
channels_search_empty: No channel or person with that name.
channel_password_text: {{arg1}} needs a password. It is kept in the secure storage of this phone.

microphone_denied_settings: Mumcord may not use the microphone. Tap here and allow “Microphone” for Mumcord in the system settings.
notifications_text: Mumcord shows a running voice session as a notification, so that you can mute, deafen and leave without opening the app.

ban_no_certificate: This person has no certificate, so only their IP address can be banned.

ban_conflict_text: The entry is different on the server now. Save yours anyway, or go back.
chat_request_text: A chat request asks {{arg1}} to let you write to them, in case they only accept private messages from people they know.

settings_output_note: Used when no headset is connected

camera_blocked_text: Allow “Camera” for Mumcord in the system settings.
camera_reason_photo: Mumcord needs the camera to take a photo for the chat. Sending a picture from your photo library works without it.
camera_reason_scan: Mumcord needs the camera to read the codes on your desktop. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
identities_intro: Your identity is a certificate. Servers recognise you by it.
identities_scan_sub: Point the camera at the codes
identities_import_sub: Pick a backup from your phone
identities_file_unreadable: Mumcord could not read this file, or it is too large to be an identity.
identity_setup_text: Your identity is a certificate. Servers recognise you by it. Bring the one you use in the desktop app, or start fresh on this phone.
identity_delete_last: Mumcord needs at least one identity, so this one cannot be deleted.
identity_create_text: Mumcord creates a new certificate on this phone. Servers will see you as a new person.
identity_create_name_invalid: This name cannot be used. It needs 1 to 64 characters.
identity_import_text: Enter the password of the file. Leave it empty if the file has none.
identity_import_wrong: The password is wrong, or this file does not hold an identity.
identity_import_failed: Mumcord could not import this identity.
identity_export_text: The backup is a .p12 file protected with a password you choose now. You need that password to import it again.
identity_export_mismatch: The passwords are not the same.
identity_export_failed: Mumcord could not create the backup.
identity_delete_warning: Without a backup you lose the names and permissions registered with this identity on servers. This cannot be undone.
identity_delete_servers_one: {{arg1}} server uses this identity. It will use the default identity {{arg2}} afterwards. Its registered name and permissions stay with the old certificate.
identity_delete_servers_other: {{arg1}} servers use this identity. They will use the default identity {{arg2}} afterwards. Their registered names and permissions stay with the old certificate.
scan_hint: Keep the phone pointed at the codes on your desktop

scan_code_label: Enter the code shown on desktop
scan_camera_denied: Mumcord may not use the camera, so it cannot read the codes.
scan_camera_blocked: Mumcord may not use the camera. Allow “Camera” for Mumcord in the system settings.
scan_note_not_a_transfer: This QR code is not from the desktop app’s “Send to your phone”.
scan_note_unreadable: A code was not read correctly. Hold the phone still.
scan_note_newer_version: This transfer needs a newer version of Mumcord on this phone.
scan_note_expired: The codes are older than two minutes. Start “Send to your phone” again on the desktop and scan the new codes.
scan_note_clock_skew: The clocks of your computer and your phone differ too much. Set both to the right time and scan again.
scan_note_rescan: The code was wrong three times. Start “Send to your phone” again on the desktop and scan the new codes.
scan_note_damaged: The codes could not be put together. Start “Send to your phone” again on the desktop and scan the new codes.
scan_note_out_of_memory: This phone does not have enough free memory to check the code. Close other apps and enter the code again.
scan_note_failed: Mumcord could not check this. Try again.
scan_note_no_camera: Mumcord could not start the camera of this phone.
scan_done_nothing: Nothing new: everything is already on this phone.

about_source_sub: The code of this version on GitHub
about_licence_text: Mumcord Mobile is free software under the GNU Affero General Public License v3 only (AGPL-3.0-only). It is built on open-source software, including code from the Mumble project.
about_privacy_text: Mumcord does not track you. Besides your servers, it only contacts GitHub once a day to look for a new version (switch it off in Settings), the public server list when you open it, and the Mumcord crash server when you send a crash report yourself.
licences_failed: The licences could not be read.
update_available_text: The download opens in your browser. Installing it keeps your servers and settings.
settings_update_check_sub: Once a day, asks GitHub for a new version
crash_notice_text: A crash report was saved on this phone. It is only sent if you report the crash. Reporting it helps us fix the problem.
crash_reports_info: When Mumcord closes unexpectedly it saves a short report: time, version, phone details, what went wrong and the last log lines. Reports stay on this phone and are only sent when you report a crash yourself. Mumcord keeps the last 10.
crash_reports_failed: The crash reports could not be read.
crash_status_failed: That did not work. Try again.
crash_delete_text: The report from {{arg1}} will be removed from this phone.
crash_delete_all_text_one: {{arg1}} report will be removed from this phone.
crash_delete_all_text_other: {{arg1}} reports will be removed from this phone.
crash_upload_comment_placeholder: For example: I was listening in a channel when the app closed.
crash_upload_where: Sent to the Mumcord team at crash.mumcord.app over an encrypted connection. Kept for 90 days.
crash_upload_shared: Shared: the Mumcord version, what went wrong, which features were in use, the last log lines and your phone's system details (such as the Android version, processor and memory). None of this names you, but together these details can identify this phone.
crash_upload_failed: The report could not be sent. Check your connection and try again; it stays on this phone.
crash_upload_unreadable: This report could not be read.
stream_unreachable_no_path: Stream not reachable from this network
stream_unreachable_peer_to_peer_off: Peer-to-peer is off for this server.
stream_unreachable_direct_declined: You said no to direct connections and this server has no relay.
stream_unreachable_relay_unavailable: The relay can't be used right now.
stream_unreachable_needs_update: {{arg1}} needs a newer Mumcord for this.
direct_connections_body: Direct connections are faster, but the other person can see your IP address. Mumcord uses them for streams with other Mumcord users. If you say no, streams come through the server's relay where the server has one; then the other person doesn't see your IP address.
